label: Amazing Marvin
description: Automate tasks, projects, daily planning, habits and time tracking

operations.name: create_task
operations.description: Create a task, optionally resolving title shortcuts like +today and @label.

operations.name: mark_task_done
operations.description: Mark a task done. Some client-side completion effects are not implemented by the API.

operations.name: create_project
operations.description: Create a project in the master list.

operations.name: create_event
operations.description: Create an event. Calendar sync happens in the Marvin client.

operations.name: get_tracked_task
operations.description: Read the task currently being tracked.

operations.name: list_children
operations.description: Read direct open child tasks/projects; descendants require separate calls.

operations.name: list_today_items
operations.description: Read tasks/projects scheduled for a date, including enabled rollover rules.

operations.name: list_due_items
operations.description: Read open tasks/projects due on or before a date.

operations.name: list_today_time_blocks
operations.description: Read time blocks for a date.

operations.name: list_labels
operations.description: Read the account's labels in their sort order.

operations.name: track_time
operations.description: Start or stop a task's timer. The API does not update cached task duration/times; reconcile those separately in Marvin.

operations.name: get_time_tracks
operations.description: Read authoritative time-track data for up to 100 tasks.

operations.name: get_kudos
operations.description: Read Kudos level and remaining points.

operations.name: record_habit
operations.description: Record a habit value and update its synced document (experimental).

operations.name: get_habit
operations.description: Read a habit including its history (experimental).

operations.name: list_habits
operations.description: Read habits with history; raw full-access mode is not requested (experimental).
